services.desc: Experience effortless cruising on the water with Blue Coral’s Tritoon Bennington R23 “Kemp.” This premium rental offers plush lounge seating, a spacious open deck, and a smooth 300 HP engine for both relaxation and adventure. Enjoy dual captain chairs, a rear swim platform with ladder for easy dips, and multiple entry gates for safe, convenient boarding. The full bimini top provides welcome shade, while ample space makes it perfect for families, groups of friends, or a laid-back day at the sandbar.
